easy.q: How many sets does a man need to win a Grand Slam tennis match?
easy.fact: Men play best-of-five; women play best-of-three.

easy.q: Add up every dot on a standard six-sided die. What's the total?
easy.fact: Opposite faces always add up to 7.

easy.q: How many kids are in The Brady Bunch?
How many amendments make up the Bill of Rights?
Yellowstone National Park reaches into how many states?
easy.fact: About 96% of it is in Wyoming; the rest is in Montana and Idaho.

medium.q: How many stars are on the European Union's flag?
medium.fact: The number stays at 12 no matter how many countries join.

medium.q: How many gold medals did Jesse Owens win at the 1936 Berlin Olympics?
medium.fact: He won the 100, 200, long jump and 4x100 relay.

medium.q: Minnesota's nickname says it's the land of how many lakes?
How many states joined the Confederacy?
medium.fact: South Carolina left the Union first, in December 1860.

medium.q: How old was Billie Eilish when she swept the big four Grammys in 2020?
medium.fact: She was the youngest ever to win Album of the Year at the time.

hard.q: How tall was the Great Pyramid of Giza when it was built, in feet?
hard.fact: It was the world's tallest structure for nearly 4,000 years.

hard.q: How many national parks are in California?
hard.fact: That's the most of any state.

hard.q: How many episodes of Avatar: The Last Airbender were made?
hard.fact: They're split into three 'Books': Water, Earth and Fire.

hard.q: How many Olympic gold medals has swimmer Katie Ledecky won?
hard.fact: She won her first at age 15, in London in 2012.
